risks.note: Demand disruption due to geopolitical uncertainty in key markets like Automotive, Life Sciences, Industrial and Oil & Gas is flagged as a major short-term risk for the Performance Polymer Solutions business.
risks.risk: Geopolitical demand disruption in PPS end markets

risks.note: An inflationary environment, concerns over availability of key raw materials, and logistical uncertainties are flagged as critical challenges for the PPS business in the current year; PCR also flags supply chain disruptions and price surcharges on raw materials/energy from ongoing geopolitical tensions.
risks.risk: Raw material availability and input cost inflation

risks.note: Depreciation of the Rupee is flagged as a risk specifically because the Performance Polymer Solutions business is import-intensive.

The Abrasives business faces margin pressure on key high-margin products from global players entering India and rising Chinese imports (power tools accessory range); the Silicon Carbide business faces competition from imports mainly from China, Vietnam and Russia, which kept market prices subdued and pressured margins/volumes during the year.
risks.risk: Import competition and pricing pressure across Abrasives and Silicon Carbide

risks.note: Saint-Gobain Ceramic Materials Bhutan Private Limited (SGCMBPL), the Company's SiC-manufacturing subsidiary, saw its business subdued during the year on account of increased power and input costs.
risks.risk: Subsidiary performance sensitivity to power/input costs

risks.note: PCR exports declined during the year due to the uncertain geopolitical situation and the imposition of tariffs in the US.
risks.risk: PCR export decline from geopolitical/tariff risk

risks.note: The captive IT unit operates on a cost-plus model for the Saint-Gobain Group; management states growth in this segment is limited and future growth can happen only on account of cost inflation, and financial performance may be impacted by foreign exchange fluctuation and hedging strategy.
risks.risk: Structurally limited growth in Digital Services (INDEC) segment

risks.note: Paint, Adhesives and similar companies entering the Abrasives market with deep distribution and aggressive pricing have been able to penetrate the market quickly, adding to competitive pressure alongside established European/Japanese niche players and Chinese imports.
risks.risk: Competitive intensity from new entrants adjacent to Abrasives
